name: sol10-mobile-reuse
goal: Keep shared-workspace function views inside the admitted viewport before recording

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Hosted function views exceed 390px by 13px. Keep the full document inside its selected viewport before saving captures.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Catalog fixtures omit the workspace header. Strengthen the existing function capture helper to reject document overflow and name escaping elements.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed test 20473de6a1 failed with a 403px document at 390px; record edcab33c31df retains the actual assertion.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: fc3b36d698 hides the mobile search text inside its existing compact button; its accessible name and desktop label remain.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged command and environment pass all nine cases at fc3b36d698. Paired record 0b6c1574fb4c retains the committed test corpus.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
